title: PCI Map short summary
description: One entry of data/summaries.yaml: a short own-words summary of an element that is not curated in data/curated yet (no timing). Written from the fiche text published on PCI Lab or from the official fiche; drafts until Paul reviews them.

kind.description: event = recurring, datable tradition; practice = know-how or practice with no public date.

read.description: Where the fiche text was read: pcilab = the element's PCI Lab page (data/places.yaml gives its id); fiche = the official fiche PDF.
